University-partner courses

Portage Learning

Online science labs, healthcare prerequisites and general education courses with a college-issued transcript.

Research profile · confirm exact school and course acceptance

How the credit works

College credit through Geneva College or Bushnell University. The transcript issuer depends on the student’s state of residence when registering.

Pace and learning format

Open enrollment and self-directed study. The microbiology syllabus sets a 28-day minimum and 48 hours between module or final exams; grading adds time.

Costs to check

Published general tuition is $230 USD per credit, including required learning materials, transcript, application and technology fees. Payment is due at enrollment.

Check the current checkout terms and the costs that apply to your actual course list. Membership time, assessments, materials, retakes, transcripts, and school fees may need separate attention.

Assessments and requirements

Coursework includes assignments and exams. The microbiology syllabus requires Respondus LockDown Browser with webcam recording; prerequisites and lab acceptance vary by program.

Before you commit

  • Choose the exact receiving school, degree, and catalog year.
  • Confirm this specific course, recommendation or transcript source—not only the provider’s name.
  • Ask which requirement the learning will satisfy and check duplicate-credit, grade, date, and source limits.
  • Keep a written school decision before paying for an outside course you need for graduation.
